title: Beyond Knowledge Transfer: How User Overlap Shapes Diversity in Cross-Domain Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30156v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A common paradigm in cross-domain recommendation (CDR) transfers knowledge through users shared by source and target domains. Although this overlap bridge is effective in improving accuracy, its effect on diversity remains unclear. We identify two bottlenecks: the bridge can be too narrow when overlapping users cover limited target-domain tastes, and too loud when shared signals dominate the sparse personal evidence of non-overlapping users. To address both, we propose DivCDR, a model-agnostic Push--Pull framework. Pull constructs confidence-gated virtual positives for overlapping users and optimizes their exposure-entropy gain, broadening the preferences carried by the bridge. Push uses overlap-density-guided negative sampling to move non-overlapping users away from overlap-dense regions. translated_title: 超越知识迁移：用户重叠如何塑造跨领域推荐中的多样性
translated_abstract: 跨领域推荐（CDR）中的一种常见范式是通过源领域和目标领域共享的用户来迁移知识。尽管这种重叠桥梁在提高准确性方面行之有效，但其对多样性的影响仍不明确。我们识别出两个瓶颈：当重叠用户所覆盖的目标领域偏好有限时，桥梁会“过窄”；当共享信号压过非重叠用户稀疏的个人证据时，桥梁会“过响”。为解决这两个问题，我们提出了DivCDR，一个与模型无关的“推—拉”框架。Pull（拉）为重叠用户构建置信度门控的虚拟正样本，并优化其曝光熵增益，从而拓宽桥梁所承载的偏好范围；Push（推）则采用重叠密度引导的负采样，使非重叠用户远离重叠密集的区域。在三个数据集和五个代表性CDR骨干模型上的实验表明，DivCDR在保持或提升准确性的同时改善了推荐多样性。
tldr: 提出与模型无关的DivCDR推拉框架，通过为重叠用户构建置信度门控的虚拟正样本拓宽偏好桥梁，并用重叠密度引导的负采样将非重叠用户推离重叠密集区域，在保持准确性的同时显著提升跨领域推荐的多样性。
en_tdlr: DivCDR, a model-agnostic Push-Pull framework, broadens the user-overlap bridge via confidence-gated virtual positives and pushes non-overlapping users away from overlap-dense regions, improving recommendation diversity while preserving or enhancing accuracy.
